column1: # Documented deviations from the literal data of App. C (docs/data/us4325121_appC.tsv): variable<TAB>composition, msb first<TAB>source

# Sources independent of the RTL: manual (M68000PRM par. 4, instruction descriptions), measurements against the reference core with comparison benches made during development, not part of this repository (available from the author on request: diff-fuzz-si per instruction family, lockstep-si, reset).

column3: CONFIRMED: M68000PRM par. 4, CHK: trap if Dn < 0 or Dn > bound, no trap with Dn = bound (Dn - ub = 0: N = 0, Z = 1); with the letter of App. C ("nv = n^v") the case Dn = bound would trap; measurement: diff-fuzz-si family CHK, case CHK Dn,D3 with Dn = bound = 0x000A: no trap on either core, D0 = 0 and CCR = 10

CONFIRMED: App. C code e/1e, values 00 -> 10, 10 -> 11, x1 -> 00/01: the low bit is END (end of list: output 00/01), the high bit is the size IRD6 (word 10, long 11); with the literal order of REMARKS ("end^ir[6]", end msb) MOVEM word and long would swap paths; measurement: diff-fuzz-si families MOVEM and MOVEMR
